headline: AI sector is where everyone is hiding, but the concentration echoes past bubbles — not clear whether it solves the debt problem or ends badly
reasoning: Perry observes that the entire market rally is concentrated in AI stocks, with everything else flat or underwater. He is not making a definitive call but draws a parallel to past episodes where liquidity-driven manias in a narrow pocket of the market did not end well. He leaves open the possibility that AI could be transformative for productivity and debt reduction, but his base case is caution given the historical pattern.
